1. For each session, find the first event where option='detail' or path='/complete'
2. Count all events before that first event with non-empty search_type
3. Find the minimum count and return all sessions with that count

WITH pre_click_events AS (
  SELECT 
    session,
    stamp,
    path,
    search_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS event_rank,
    CASE 
      WHEN option = 'detail' OR path = '/complete' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_target_event
  FROM log.main.activity_log
),
session_first_target AS (
  SELECT 
    session,
    MIN(event_rank) AS first_target_rank
  FROM pre_click_events
  WHERE is_target_event = 1
  GROUP BY session
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.session,
    COUNT(*) AS pre_click_count
  FROM pre_click_events p
  JOIN session_first_target s ON p.session = s.session AND p.event_rank < s.first_target_rank
  WHERE p.search_type != ''
  GROUP BY p.session
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) AS min_count
  FROM session_counts
)
SELECT 
  s.session,
  p.path,
  p.search_type
FROM session_counts s
JOIN min_count m ON s.pre_click_count = m.min_count
JOIN pre_click_events p ON s.session = p.session AND p.event_rank < s.pre_click_count
WHERE p.search_type != ''
ORDER BY s.session, p.event_rank;
